description: Split Check: before paying into (or trusting) an on-chain revenue split, verify what it actually pays. Detects 0xSplits v2 splits on Base / Base Sepolia, proves a claimed recipients+allocations config against the on-chain splitHash (or discovers it from recent events), shows each recipient's share, whether a given beneficiary is included, whether the split is immutable (no owner), and USDC waiting to be distributed. Read-only. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/split-check, $0.002 via x402.)
name: split_check
